definitions.explanation: A system or device for warming a room or building. Also refers to the act of heating.

examples.japanese: {暖房|だんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{暖房|だんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いていて→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: The heating is working and it's warm.

examples.japanese: {暖房|だんぼう}⟦{代|だい}→代：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暖房|だんぼう}⟦なし→無し：03779_nashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In winter, I can't live without heating.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧{暖房|だんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついて→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
{暖房|だんぼう} refers to heating systems. The opposite is ⟦{冷房|れいぼう}→冷房：01755_reibou⟧ (air conditioning/cooling).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {暖房|だんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to turn on the heating
- {暖房|だんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to turn off the heating
- {暖房|だんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: heating works/is effective
- {暖房|だんぼう}⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧: heating equipment

TYPES OF HEATING:
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧: air conditioner (heating/cooling)
- ⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧: heater, stove
- ⟦こたつ→炬燵：05070_kotatsu⟧: heated table
- ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧{暖房|だんぼう}: floor heating

OPPOSITE: ⟦{冷房|れいぼう}→冷房：01755_reibou⟧ (cooling, air conditioning)
